mentions.name: ChargerRadius
mentions.description: A web app that helps drivers find nearby EV chargers quickly and open directions instantly. It includes a Tesla integration, though the core charger lookup and directions work without it.
mentions.problem: Existing charging apps are map-heavy and slow when you already roughly know where you are and just want nearby options fast.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://chargeradius.com, a web app to help drivers find nearby EV chargers quickly and open directions instantly.
